title: Lung Cancer - Symptoms, Types, & Treatment | Dr. Randeep Singh
description: Cancer that begins in the lungs and most often occurs in people who smoke. Cancer starts when cells in the body begin to grow out of control. It is a malignant lung tumor that reduces a person's ability to breathe.  Dr. Randeep Singh, Director & Senior Consultant - Medical Oncology at Narayana Superspeciality Hospital, Gurugram talks about Lung Cancer.
